Today, Faber Group is still family-owned, entrepreneurial, and focused on the long term, guided by its values care, dare, and deliver. It has grown into one of the largest players in pallet pooling and circular logistics in Europe. Its customers include many of the biggest A-brand manufacturers and retailers on the continent, which puts Faber at the table where supply chains are designed. Many of those customers use more than one pooling system, and Faber is the only provider that offers all three, open, closed, and exclusive. That unique position lets customers arrange everything with one partner instead of several. Sustainability is one of Faber's greatest strengths, and in this market it matters more every year. Retailers and manufacturers face growing reporting demands, sharpened by new European packaging regulation (PPWR), and they increasingly bring in Faber to help meet them. EcoVadis has awarded Faber its Platinum rating six years in a row, which places it among the top 1% of companies assessed.
